title: Two-stage rerank selection harness, multilingual confidence calibration, and throughput profiles
creator: Ibrahim Malik
description:
Problem: The current reranking endpoint faces trade-offs between quality and latency when moving between heavy cross-encoder variants (high-quality, high-latency) and compact quantized variants (lower-cost, lower-quality). We need an engineering plan and evaluation harness to select model variants per workload, verify multilingual quality parity, and produce throughput/latency profiles so routing policies can make optimal decisions.

Goal: Deliver a repeatable two-stage selection + calibration system: (1) bi-encoder shortlist + lightweight compact cross-encoder fast-rescore; (2) fallback to full-precision cross-encoder for edge cases identified by calibrated confidence. Provide per-locale calibration maps, p50/p95/p99 latency and throughput profiles for each variant, and automated regression checks that tie into CI and canary rollouts.
acceptance_criteria: A1: Evaluation harness that runs end-to-end rerank flows against a multilingual test corpus and outputs precision@k, MRR, latency percentiles, and throughput for each model variant.
A2: Per-locale calibration curves and confidence thresholds that map compact model scores to expected full-model rank delta; thresholds stored as config and consumable by routing layer.
A3: Canary policy templates that use throughput/latency profiles + quality thresholds to route <10%/25%/50% traffic to new variants with automatic rollback on regression alerts.
A4: Automated CI checks that will fail on quality regression >3% relative drop on critical locales or increase in p99 latency >25% for the rerank endpoint.
A5: Documentation and runbook for troubleshooting score mis-calibration and manual rollback steps.
technical_notes: Design a two-stage pipeline: bi-encoder shortlist (existing bi-encoder endpoint) -> compact cross-encoder rescoring (quantized, int8) -> optionally full cross-encoder if confidence below threshold.
Compact variants: evaluate QAT/int8 variants of cross-encoders and measure sequence-length sensitivity; ensure KV cache reuse is compatible across quantized and full models.
Confidence calibration: use temperature-scaling per-locale on softmaxed scores and compute expected rank-change distribution using a historical validation set.
Latency budgets: enforce p95 < 120ms for compact-rescore path and p99 < 500ms for full-rescore fallback under target RPS for Dedicated customers.
Routing integration: routing layer should expose per-request decision reason tags (shortlist-only, compact-rescore, full-rescore-fallback) for observability.
Instrumentation: enrich Console with breakdowns per-stage: shortlist time, transfer time, compact rescore time, full rescore time, model selection decision path.
Dataset: assemble a multilingual corpus covering 12 locales with balanced short/long queries and adversarial paraphrases; label top-5 relevance via internal annotators and prior production signals.
test_plan: Unit tests for calibration code and mapping persistence.
Integration tests: run harness end-to-end on a 100k-sample multilingual set producing metrics and comparing to baseline reranker (current full cross-encoder) for stability.
Performance tests: run load profile generator to produce target RPS for Hosted and Dedicated modes; measure p50/p95/p99 and throughput for each variant and mixed traffic fractions.
Regression checks in CI: add nightly job that computes delta to baseline and posts report to PR; block merges when critical-locale quality falls >3%.
Human-in-the-loop: sample 200 decisions per-locale where compact->full fallback fired and verify fallback correctness via annotator review.
rollout_plan: Step 0: Feature branch + unit/integration tests. Internal demo to PM/Design and applied-ML leads.
Step 1: Run full offline evaluation and publish throughput/latency/quality matrix to docs and Console benchmark dashboard.
Step 2: Canary 1 (5% traffic) to compact-rescore path for low-risk locales with automatic rollback on regression alerts for quality or latency.
Step 3: Canary 2 (20% traffic) expand locales and enable compact->full fallback path; collect fallback frequency and annotator samples.
Step 4: Gradual increase to 100% for compact-rescore where compact quality is within thresholds; keep full-rescore enabled as rare fallback and monitor cost impact.
Step 5: Post-rollout: run 7-day quality regression and resource-cost audit; update Optimize recommendations with new quantization profiles.
risks: Calibration drift: locale distributions may shift over time causing increased fallback and cost overruns.
Metric leakage: differences between offline labeled corpora and production user intent could hide regressions—needs human review sampling.
KV cache incompatibility: switching between quantized and full-precision models may prevent efficient KV cache reuse leading to latency spikes.
Operational complexity: more decision paths increase surface area for bugs and observability gaps; require extra SLI dashboards.
